message: Hey Jane, how's your day going? Any funny stories from the kiddos today?
Reminder: Staff meeting at 4 PM in the main hall.
Hi Jane, just wanted to say thanks again for looking after Max yesterday!

Jane, I think you may be the right person to tell... Some of the children in my care were whispering about my parents' behaviors, mentioning something about alleged drug use. I don't know whether it's true or not, but I just feel horrified. What shall I do now? - Timmy
Hope you had a good day at work, see you at home soon.
Today was so hectic, but the kids were great as always.
Hey Jane, I'm running late, can you please wait with Emily for another 15 mins?
Of course, no problem at all, Bob!
Lunch menu: Spaghetti Bolognese with a side of mixed veggies.
All the kids loved the spaghetti today, barely any left for the staff!
